title: Dimension inequality for finite type algebras over a Noetherian domain
statement:
Let $R\subset S$ be an inclusion of commutative domains, with $R$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $S$ a finite type $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. For primes $\mathfrak p\subset R$ and $\mathfrak q\subset S$ with $\mathfrak q\cap R=\mathfrak p$, write $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\operatorname{Frac}(R/\mathfrak p)$ and $\kappa(\mathfrak q)=\operatorname{Frac}(S/\mathfrak q)$, and let $\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak r)$ be the supremum of lengths of strict chains of primes ending at $\mathfrak r$. With transcendence degree as in [def-kun-transcendence-degree] ($\operatorname{trdeg}_RS$ being that of the $R$-algebra $S$), one has
$$
\operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak q)\leq \operatorname{ht}(\mathfrak p)+\operatorname{trdeg}_{R}S-\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(\mathfrak p)}\kappa(\mathfrak q).
$$
